citation: Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards 39 (1947), 453–477
evidence_paraphrase: Recovered from the official NIST Digital Archives. Fourteen candidate rows visually verified. Energy is in US international J/g, converted with NBS Circular 475 and explicit molar masses. The small beta term depends on historical vapor-pressure slopes and liquid volumes from API Project 44 / International Critical Tables; original per-compound ancillary entries have not been traced. Retained outside the primary independent-label pool. Pure ethylbenzene series selected; no merging with impure series.

Three current-work values at 25 C. Methoxy/ethoxy values include corrections for measured water uptake; propoxy needs no material water-uptake correction. Quoted deviations are twice SE of the mean. Overall uncertainty is printed <=0.1 kJ/mol. The water constant 2.433 kJ/g is retained as printed, with its imperfect cited-reference trace disclosed. Reference 4 prints Acta22 p.2434, which falls in a different article; intended p.2438 is plausible but not silently substituted.

Two acetate values at 25.00 C, real vapor at saturation. Quoted deviations are twice SE of the mean. The scan prints overall uncertainty >=0.2 kJ/mol; no upper bound is inferred. Methoxy compounds gained about 0.02 percent water during measurement and were not corrected. Retained with explicit quality flags under the existing primary-calorimetry policy; recommended source-exclusion sensitivity is prescribed before modeling.
